patchNotes:
DC: Dark Legion is updating today, June 3 Check out the patch notes below:
Reminder: Dev plans are always subject to change. Watch your in-game announcements for the most accurate information. Changes related to your feedback are marked with 

  New Content  ,
Hypertime Tracker updates on some servers. Check your in-game patch notes for the info relevant to your Earth.,
Red Hood Knightfight's Legacy Piece: Knightbow, is now available.,

 Limited-Time Event: Wheel of Fate (Available on June 8) ,
Spend Order Tokens to spin the wheel and get rewards. Accumulate spins to unlock milestone rewards.,

 Updates: Combat Cycle  ,
Made major updates to the Combat Cycle boss mechanics and adjusted the damage thresholds for Milestone reward.,
Added daily recommended faction tags to Phase I. In Phase II, one limited Mythic or Iconic Champion from each recommended faction will be randomly chosen as the daily featured Champion. Deploy the featured Champion to receive a bonus upon battle settlement. Champions with higher star levels provide greater bonuses.,
Vehicles can now be deployed in Combat Cycle.,

 Improvements: Battlefield ,
Improved target occupation rules: Targets will no longer remain occupied by an attacking squad while it is returning from battle. Other squads can now attack or launch Coordinated Assaults against the same target during that time.,

Adjustments: Fire Put-Out Mechanic ,
Added a 10-minute cooldown after assisting league members with putting out fires.,

 Improvements: Great Krypton Rush ,
Improved matchmaking to reduce cases where no opponent is found.,
Added a new option that allows matchmaking across different time slots.,

  Improvements: Guardian Challenge  ,
Improved the visuals of Commanders' Bases and Productive Buildings on the mini-map.,

  Improvements: Gear Transmutation  ,
Improved high-quality attribute odds: High-quality attributes can now appear at lower transmutation levels, with the chances increasing as the transmutation level rises. Odds at level 5 remain unchanged.,

  Improvements ,
Increased the friend limit to 200. ,

  Fixes  ,
Fixed an issue where league joining requirements weren't applied.,
Fixed an issue that could occur during base relocation.,
Fixed a display issue in scout reports.,
Fixed various text and display issues.
